title: AI Cluster High-Performance Storage Selection: DeepSeek 3FS vs. Lustre/GPFS vs. WEKA/VAST vs. Object FUSE + GDS Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Standard Corporate NFS / Uncached S3/GCS FUSE + Raw Unpacked Small Files (CPU Page-Cache Bounce)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: MDS metadata storms on small files + 18.5 GB/s bandwidth stall 512 GPUs 38.4% of the time

tiers.name: Tier 2: Cloud Object Storage (S3 Mountpoint / GCS FUSE) + Local NVMe Read Cache + 256MB WebDataset/MDS Shards
tiers.verdict: Best cloud-native TCO for general training data loading, but lacks sub-ms random read for KV Cache pools

tiers.name: Tier 3: Dedicated Parallel File System (Managed Lustre / WEKA / VAST Data) + GPUDirect Storage (`cuFile`)
tiers.verdict: Turnkey enterprise SLA & 1.28 TB/s GDS throughput, carries dedicated storage appliance CapEx/OpEx

tiers.name: Tier 4: Converged RDMA NVMe Fabric (`DeepSeek 3FS` / Local NVMe Pool + GDS/USRBIO + 2.1s Async Ckpt + Tiered Object)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: Aggregates 64 nodes' local PCIe Gen5 NVMe over RDMA for 2.34 TB/s read, 2.1s stall & -82.0% TCO
